trailhead.label: Sportplatz Vöran bus stop, the board’s start

cautions: Wide forest road shared with farm and forestry vehicles: lead on.
Meadows beside the road are farmed and closed to dogs in Vöran: keep to the road.
Short stretch on the Hafling road into the village at the end: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Vöran to Hafling past the Bruggen pond: Da Vöran a Hafling passando per lo stagno di Bruggen
textIt.Sportplatz Vöran bus stop, the board’s s: Fermata dell'autobus Sportplatz Vöran, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.Wide forest road shared with farm and fo: Ampia strada forestale condivisa con mezzi agricoli e forestali: guinzaglio.
textIt.Meadows beside the road are farmed and c: I prati accanto alla strada sono coltivati e a Vöran sono vietati ai cani: resta sulla strada.
textIt.Short stretch on the Hafling road into t: Breve tratto sulla strada di Hafling entrando in paese alla fine: tieni il cane vicino.
